assumption_tags.namespace_note: This certificate is not an RP-* assumption test. It closes a proof obligation on an EXISTING Science Forge conjecture, and is the first result in this stream to engage the programme's own open corpus rather than a carrier built to demonstrate the method.

claim_boundary: In a zero-axiom Rocq development, the coprime-ratio obstruction can be carried only at order p+q-2 and not below, and exactly one of the two kernel combinations can carry it, determined by the parity of q. Six even-p loci are computed unobstructed past their predicted order, and four new odd-p instances confirm the order law.
does_not_establish: that an obstruction DOES occur at odd p. The order law says where one CAN appear, never that one does; non-vanishing remains observational, now on nine instances
why the even-p coefficient vanishes. Neither the degree count nor the involution explains it -- both go through unchanged at even p -- so the vanishing is DYNAMICAL and is now the sharp open question
the word-generator model from the implementation. That a word at order n is n cubic vertices joined by n-1 Moyal brackets is a MODELLING INPUT stated as a recurrence, not derived from moyal_hi.forge
the conjecture as a whole. It stays at VERIFIED_ON_FIXTURES; the order and kernel clauses are proved, the non-vanishing clause is not
8:3 and 6:5 at their predicted orders. Both were computed only to order 6, below their predicted 9, so they confirm the selection rule without reaching the critical order
any quantum, causal, or field-theoretic claim about Weyl gravity itself — see the report's physics section, which is interpretation

interpretation_superseded_by.what: The PHYSICS READING in the report's §5 — that the obstruction is the ghost's escape route and that even p closes it — is RETRACTED. The obstruction conserves a positive-definite charge and therefore bounds both occupations, and the free Hamiltonian as coded is positive definite in the first place.

theorems.name: word_degree_is_order_plus_two
theorems.role: the cubic vertex contributes 3 and each Moyal bracket removes 2, so n vertices and n-1 brackets give 3n-2(n-1); EXACTLY, not at most
theorems.statement: a word at order n is homogeneous of degree exactly n+2

theorems.name: resonant_at_critical_degree
theorems.role: coprimality forces n1-m1 = kq and n2-m2 = -kp, and the degree budget forces |k| <= 1; this is where the coprimality does its work
theorems.statement: at total degree p+q with p,q coprime, a nonnegative resonant monomial is diagonal, the conversion kernel, or its conjugate

theorems.name: order_law
theorems.role: THE ORDER CLAUSE, previously OBSERVED with 'no ansatz proof exists'
theorems.statement: the kernel can be carried only at order n = p+q-2

theorems.name: selection_rule_below_the_critical_order
theorems.role: the selection rule -- the vanishing of every lower order, which the five original fixtures had verified case by case
theorems.statement: and below that order the kernel cannot appear at all

theorems.name: symmetric_kernel_iff_q_even
theorems.role: THE KERNEL CLAUSE, refined: the symmetry follows q parity, NOT order parity
theorems.statement: the symmetric combination survives exactly when q is even

theorems.name: antisymmetric_kernel_iff_q_odd
theorems.statement: and the antisymmetric combination exactly when q is odd

theorems.name: exactly_one_kernel_survives
theorems.role: what makes the rule a constraint rather than a description: the other combination is FORBIDDEN, not merely unobserved

theorems.name: all_nine_computed_loci_agree
theorems.role: a non-vacuity check against the corpus, including the four instances computed for this result
theorems.statement: the rule matches all nine computed loci
